description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of git's skip-worktree bit functionality within a git repository. It sets up test cases for various scenarios involving files with skip-worktree flags, verifies the output of git commands, and ensures correct handling of such files.

methods.name: setup_absent
methods.description: Removes file '1' if it exists and updates the git index to set 'skip-worktree' attribute for it.

methods.name: test_absent
methods.description: Verifies that the file '1' has the expected stage in git and confirms that the file is absent from the working directory.

methods.name: setup_dirty
methods.description: Replaces file '1' with a 'dirty' state, updates the index, and sets the skip-worktree attribute.

methods.name: test_dirty
methods.description: Checks that the file '1' is correctly staged with the expected blob and that its working directory content is 'dirty'.
